{{Quote|We preserve our history|Ash'ad motto|<ref name="Banner">{{TORcite|exp=strongholds|type=other|Banner: Ash'ad}}</ref>}}
The '''Ash'ad''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] organization on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|We've been tracking a clan that went rogue during the war with Zakuul. Those scum have made their way to Onderon. I need these shabuir to be stripped of any sign they ever knew the word 'Mandalorian'.|[[Mandalore the Avenger]]|<ref name="Mission" />}}
[[File:Ashad.png|thumb|left|250px|The Ash'ad on Onderon]]
Made up of dissatisfied surviving members of [[Clan Lok]] and other like-minded Mandalorians, the group was led by [[Mirli Lok]] and before the [[Raid on Darvannis]], they would come into an alliance with [[Regalun Petryph|King Petryph]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. In exchange for contributing beast trophies to the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]], Petryph allowed the Ash'ad to do as they pleased as they hunted the dangerous beasts for honor and glory, but he did not realize that Mirli and her followers held a low view of the King.<ref name="Codex" />

The Ash'ad would continue to do as they pleased during the [[war against Zakuul]]. However, after the war and the [[third Galactic War]] breaking out soon after, their location was discovered by [[Mandalore the Avenger]], and to ensure the dishonor they brought upon the Clans, Shae tasked the [[Alliance Commander|Commander of the Alliance]] with destroying the Ash'ad and stripping them of their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Beskar'gam]] to cleanse the stain of honor brought by them.<ref name="Mission" />

<div style="float: right">[[File:Ashad_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|The Ash'ad on Ruhnuk]]</div>
Eventually, the Ash'ad fell under the leadership of [[Durn Wynnward]] and joined the splinter faction known as the [[Hidden Chain]], where they acted to conserve Mandalorian history and lore. They helped participate in the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', where they tried to recover relics relevant to Mandalorian history.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>
